reproduction.workflow_pr_association: Use Actions API pull_requests; then explicit PR number in display_title; then exact PR head SHA; then a unique PR head branch. Every run records the association_basis and per-PR head_relation_to_pr; leave unmatched when evidence is absent or ambiguous.
reproduction.workflow_commands_source: .github/workflows/test.yml and .github/workflows/daily-smoke.yml at the recorded baseline SHA

limitations: GitHub list endpoints provided the newest requested samples; job-failure counts overlap by run.
Workflow wall-clock is createdAt to updatedAt and includes queueing; it is not runner execution time.
Classification is limited to job/failed-step metadata unless a run log is explicitly cited in the Markdown report.
PR association sources are recorded per run; an empty mapping means no exact association was observed, not that the run is unrelated.
Branch Protection was inspected read-only and was not changed.
The readable sample index is generated from these JSON arrays; it is a navigation view and not an independent source.
